title: Quietly Braised American Beef Stew
description: A rich and chewy monsoon American dish featuring ginger garlic paste, this low-glycemic-friendly stew is braised to perfection in a bamboo tray. It is a hearty and comforting meal for a cold day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ginger garlic paste, salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and brown the beef cubes on all sides.
Transfer the browned beef cubes to a bamboo tray.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the skillet and cook for a few minutes.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for a minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Pour the broth mixture over the beef cubes in the bamboo tray.
Cover the tray with aluminum foil and braise the stew in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours.
